_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S9 UPPAbaby). UPPAbaby VISTA (double mode) — current VISTA V3 chassis + RumbleSeat V3 second seat. Uses CLEK'S OWN upper adapter for UPPAbaby PLUS the UPPAbaby lower adapter 0918-LMA-WW for a car seat in the lower position. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: UPPAbaby VISTA V3 (double mode; Vista + RumbleSeat)

clekListed.clekRow: UPPAbaby Vista (Double Mode) — Upper: Adapters for Vista & Cruz (0919-UMA-WW); Lower: Adapters for Vista (0918-LMA-WW). Vista/V2/V3 made 2015-present only.

priceSources.retailer: Albee Baby (Vista V3 Double + RumbleSeat V3 bundle)

specs._weightNote: Vista V3 frame + toddler seat 27.6 lb; the RumbleSeat V3 second seat adds ~9 lb when fitted for double mode.
specs._dimsNote: Same chassis footprint as Vista single (in-line double stacks vertically, not wider). Fold dims are for the frame + toddler seat; RumbleSeat removed to fold.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: from birth in either position (two bassinets / two car seats / seat + RumbleSeat combos)

specs._capacityNote: Toddler seat 50 lb + RumbleSeat V3 40 lb (combined up to ~90 lb). 30+ configurations single-to-double.

safety.notes: 5-point harness on both seats; in-line (tandem) double; RumbleSeat forward- or parent-facing.

specs.foldType: one-piece fold with auto-lock (RumbleSeat removed to fold)
specs.recline: toddler seat lay-flat; RumbleSeat multi-position recline
specs.tires: never-flat foam-filled rubber-coated tires; all-wheel suspension; front swivel with lock

notes: Vista in double mode = Vista V3 chassis ($999.99) + separately purchased RumbleSeat V3 ($299.99), effective ~$1,299.98. In double mode a Clek Liing can ride upper (adapter-clek-uppababy) and/or lower via UPPAbaby's lower adapter 0918-LMA-WW (adapter-0918-lma-ww) — hence two adapterIds. Clek compatibility applies only to 2015+ units. Large full-size tandem — far from the light city goal but a top growing-family choice. Image reuses the Vista V3 chassis shot.
